messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate for Paloma Corp (dedicated-us-east-1) on inference-gateway. 5xx=~12% over 5m. Paging @dana_oncall. ticket INC-20260315-PA1.

dana_oncall: acked — I'm on it. seeing p95 latency climb to ~1.8s for paloma routes, spike started ~17:11 UTC. pulling logs now.

lucas_sre: joining. initial grep shows repeated kernel OOMs and pod restarts on gpu-node-07. autoscaler logs show failed scale events: "scale_up error: insufficient resources".

meera_csm: looping in CSMs/account team — Paloma Ops primary contacts: Carla Vega <carla.vega@paloma.co>, Amir Khan (CTO) <amir@paloma.co>, ops@paloma.co. SLA: 99.9 latency SLO, enterprise contract. They are likely already seeing errors.

rachel_sea: drafting tailored customer notice for approval: "We are investigating increased errors affecting API calls for Paloma Corp. You may see failed requests and elevated latency. Our engineers are actively mitigating — we'll provide updates every 30 minutes or sooner. Contact: ops@paloma.co."
Please confirm tone and ETA (propose ETA 30m for mitigation).

tom_support: recommend immediate routing: page Paloma primary on-call list, escalate to enterprise success after 15m if no improvement. Also enable emergency fallback routing to paloma-fallback-cluster.

dana_oncall: mitigation plan I'm executing now: 1) drain gpu-node-07; 2) scale up fallback cluster; 3) apply temporary traffic split 70/30 to fallback. Commands:
```
# cordon & drain problem node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-07
kubectl drain gpu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --force
# increase fallback deployment replicas
kubectl -n prod scale deploy paloma-inference-fallback --replicas=8
# update routing weight (traffic-split)
kubectl -n prod patch svc paloma-gateway -p '{"spec":{"trafficSplit":{"fallback":30}}}'
```
I'll update when each step completes.

lucas_sre: executed node drain and scaled fallback. noticed high memory churn on model shard loader; reduce batch size to 8 on active variant to lower mem pressure. Applying config:
```
# set smaller batch size via configmap
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/paloma-inference MAIN_BATCH_SIZE=8
```

lucas_sre: partial mitigation observed — 5xx down from 12% -> 2.1% over last 4m, p95 now ~1.1s. continuing to monitor.

meera_csm: thanks. approving status message below. Suggest we include tailored impact and contact routing snippet for Paloma account ops email and our SE. Proposed status page blurb and customer email: 
"We are investigating an issue causing increased error rates and latency for Paloma Corp customers using the dedicated inference gateway in us-east-1. Some API requests may fail or be slower than normal. Our engineers are mitigating; expected improvement within 30 minutes. If you need immediate assistance, contact ops@paloma.co or your Redwood account team (rachel.sea@redwood.ai)."

rachel_sea: small edits: include explicit note about no data exposure and that queued requests are being retried automatically. final: add line "No customer data was accessed or exfiltrated."

statuspage_bot: Posted status: "Investigating — Elevated error rates impacting Paloma Corp (dedicated-us-east-1). Updates every 30m." status_id: SP-20260315-PA1.

tom_support: routed outbound customer email to Paloma ops and copied account exec. also updated escalation matrix: page on-call primary -> if >15m escalate to SE + CSM -> if >60m open dedicated incident call with customer.

dana_oncall: monitoring dashboard: errors trending down. continuing 1m cadence checks. next internal update in 10m; will hand off to overnight oncall if persists past 23:00 UTC.

lucas_sre: follow-up: we identified a combination of memory leak in model loader + aggressive autoscaler backoff on spot nodes. long-term action items: bump minimum reserved capacity for Paloma dedicated cluster, add memory guardrails on model load, and adjust autoscaler backoff policy.

meera_csm: capturing tailored customer impact statement for post-incident comms: "Between 17:11–17:45 UTC, Paloma Corp experienced higher-than-normal API error rates (peak ~12% 5xx) and increased latency due to resource exhaustion on the dedicated inference cluster. Mitigation (traffic split and scaling) reduced errors to ~2% and normalized latency. Root cause: model loader memory growth + insufficient reserved capacity. We are implementing operational changes to prevent recurrence and will follow up with a detailed post-incident report and timeline."

dana_oncall: handing off to overnight oncall @lucas_sre for continued observation. I've documented steps taken in INC-20260315-PA1. If errors resurge, follow the rollback and fallback steps above.

statuspage_bot: Status updated: "Identified — Partial mitigation in place, service partially degraded for Paloma Corp. Next update in 30m or on significant change."

meera_csm: scheduling customer touchpoint at 18:30 UTC to brief Paloma leadership, prep post-incident report draft for tomorrow.

rachel_sea: thanks team — sending internal ops summary to execs and prepping PR FAQ for Paloma. :thumbsup:
